title: Fish and Spaceships
author: Adam Biltcliffe
description:
A SpeedIF game from 2002. Like most SpeedIF from that era, it was written under a 2-hour start-to-finish time limit with a laundry list of elements to include, which leads to a game about as coherent as you'd expect.

Content warning: profanity, death in combat, Microsoft Windows XP.
